mapper.select: SELECT category, DATE_FORMAT(transaction_at, '%Y-%m') AS year_month, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM transaction_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND expense_type = 'VARIABLE' AND transaction_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL (#{monthsBack} - 1) MONTH) GROUP BY category, DATE_FORMAT(transaction_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY category, year_month

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transaction_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND transaction_type = 'EXPENSE' AND expense_type = 'VARIABLE' AND transaction_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
